data.title: Verdict: AcmeDB Is On Trial
data.subject: AcmeDB
data.take: the boring database that actually ships
data.summary: AcmeDB does ONE damn thing, durable key-value storage, and does it without demanding an operator PhD, no consensus wizardry, no sharding astrology, just a WAL, a manifest, and docs that actually answer the question you asked!

receipts.evidence: vendor benchmark on a laptop, not replicated
the docs list snapshots as 'coming soon'

data.bottom_line: Ship it behind a cache and you're good! Your crown jewels? Keep them the hell OUT of it, not even a debate.
caveats: We did not run our own benchmark. The latency number is theirs, not ours.
Checked against the docs on the date above. Roadmaps move.

p99 read latency under 2ms on a laptop.
